one_month_reasoning: Window to 2026-11-01 almost certainly contains FormFactor's Q3 2026 report (quarter ended 2026-09-26; company reported Q2 on 07-29 and historically reports Q3 in late Oct; date not yet announced). Guide was $270M +/-10M rev, $0.86 non-GAAP EPS [1]; industry read-throughs since then are strong (Micron FQ4 $54.2B rev and FQ1 guide $61.5B [3]; Advantest and Technoprobe raised full-year outlooks [5][8]), so a beat-and-raise is the likely outcome, but the stock is already up ~285% in a year, at ~$148 after a +10% day on 9/30 driven by a reported Deutsche Bank Buy initiation ($200 PT) and sector momentum [12][13], and held there after Micron's print. Beats are partly priced; Q4 guide and Technoprobe share commentary at Nvidia/TSMC matter. I use a near-symmetric distribution centred at ~$148.5 (tiny positive drift for momentum/likely beat) with ~19% one-month sigma (below the 24% implied by 85% realized vol/3.5, which is inflated by last year's re-rating, but including an earnings gap).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (2028E non-GAAP EPS $4.40 x 32x + $4.5 net cash = $145) and EV/sales (2027E rev $1.25B x 9x + net cash = $145-150), weighted 60/40, rounded to $147 for value as of Oct 2027.

inputs_detail.derivation: Q3'26 guide $0.86 annualizes to ~$3.45; assume ~12-15%/yr growth into 2028 on HBM4/custom HBM, Nvidia second-source at TSMC and CPO systems, consistent with competitor (Technoprobe +42% H1, guide raised) and tester (Advantest +20.7% revision) data; slightly above the SA analyst's $4.25 because industry read-throughs since mid-Sept (Micron FQ1 guide) are stronger.

Between FORM's 5-yr median P/E of ~42x on trough-ish earnings (GuruFocus) and a peak-cycle discount; below the 40x the SA analyst uses because by Oct 2027 the market will price 2028 earnings with memory/AI capex late-cycle risk (Micron GM ~86% [3] signals peak-like pricing).
Cash $109.8M + marketable securities $235.9M at 2026-06-27, minus small term loan (~$12M), / 79.6M diluted shares ~= $4.2; rounded up for H2 FCF (Q2 FCF $52.6M).

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: 2027E revenue $1.25B x 9.2x EV/sales = $11.5B EV + $0.35B net cash / 79.6M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Q3'26 run-rate $1.08B annualized, +~15% growth in line with probe card market expansion from a $2.68B 2025 base and competitor growth (Technoprobe 2026 guide EUR0.95-1.05bn, MJC probe card >26% growth), partially offset by share pressure from Technoprobe/Taiwan vendors.
Current EV ~ $11.3B on ~$1.08B run-rate is ~10.5x; assume modest compression as growth normalizes; consistent with 54% non-GAAP GM and ~30% operating margin.

bear.story: AI/HBM capex digestion in 2027 (memory at peak margins), Technoprobe and Taiwan vendors take share at TSMC/Nvidia; EPS ~$3.2 and multiple compresses to ~24x.

base.story: Continued AI test intensity (HBM4/4E, custom ASICs, CoWoS doubling) lifts EPS toward $4.4 in 2028; multiple drifts down to low 30s; stock roughly flat.

bull.story: Nvidia second-source ramp at TSMC, CPO systems inflect, Micron/SK capex >$25B sustains DRAM probe demand; 2028 EPS $5.5+ at ~42x.

thesis_break_reason: ~35% below today; trading there would most likely mean an AI/HBM test-demand rollover (customer capex cut or memory price break) or a visible share loss to Technoprobe at TSMC/Nvidia, not ordinary volatility.

reasoning: Why the 9/30 jump: no FormFactor 8-K or press release (EDGAR shows only Forms 4/144 since the 10-Q) [2]; Micron's FQ4 release was filed 2026-09-30 at 16:02 ET, after the close, so it cannot explain the intraday move [3]. Secondary reports attribute it to a Deutsche Bank Buy initiation ($200 PT) stating FORM is the second source of probe cards for Nvidia GPUs at TSMC, plus sector momentum [12][13][15]; I could not retrieve the bank note itself. The stock then held ~$148-149 after Micron's very strong print and FQ1 guide ($61.5B rev). Industry lane: demand evidence is uniformly strong: Micron revenue up ~4.8x y/y with capex rising [3][4], Technoprobe H1 rev +42% and 2026 guide raised to EUR0.95-1.05bn with 44-46% EBITDA margin [5], MJC record memory probe cards and >26% growth with capex up [6][7], Advantest raised FY revenue forecast 20.7% on inference/ASIC/DRAM test [8], TSMC CoWoS to double by 2028 [9]. Against that, competitors are growing faster than FORM (FORM +32% y/y in Q2 [1] vs Technoprobe +42%) and TrendForce says Technoprobe overtakes FORM in 2026 [10]; the second-source Nvidia win partly offsets. Valuation: fair value ~$147 (P/E and EV/sales) is about the current price, so the base case is roughly flat with a wide spread. Distribution: median ~$145, lognormal sigma ~0.55 (below the 85% realized, which includes the 285% re-rating, but well above a large-cap's 30%), with a fatter left tail for late-cycle semicap risk. Research was limited by Twelve Data/Alpha Vantage access (no consensus estimates).
